meta.name: memory-system
meta.description: Sets up a file-based memory system so Cowork always knows who you are, how you work, and where your projects stand. For eliminating repetitive re-introductions at session start, when building persistent context across multiple projects, or during initial Cowork onboarding. Use when the user says "claude doesn't remember me", "memory system", "persistent context", "why does it forget", "remember my preferences", "I keep re-explaining myself", or "how do I make Claude remember things".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI记住你的偏好与项目上下文，无需重复介绍
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次和AI对话都要重新介绍自己和工作背景
copy.tagline_en: Make AI remember your preferences and project context without repeated introductions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep re-explaining yourself and your work context to AI every session
